name: Aoi Tori ~L'Oiseau Bleu~
source:
Main character suddenly leaves his town and returns to his home town Haraiso. There he meets his childhood friend girl Nagi. Together they travel to the dream-like world to chase blue birds of their dreams.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/02/vn-of-month-january-2001.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
主人公突然离开现在居住的城镇，回到故乡哈莱索。在那里，他与青梅竹马本城凪重逢。两人一同前往如梦似幻的世界，追寻象征他们梦想的青鸟。

[引自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/02/vn-of-month-january-2001.html]vndbreview[/url]]
